records.title: TRIPURA INTERNATION PINAPPLE FESTIVAL-2026
details:
Tripura's Queen variety pineapple is India's pride — GI-tagged, intensely sweet, and grown across 15,000+ hectares in the lush hills of Northeast India. Tripura is India's 3rd largest pineapple producer.
Tripura Global Pineapple Festival 2026 is org
India's first dedicated international pineapple exhibition — celebrating Tripura's GI-tagged Queen
